case_caption: Hartmann — State Civil Rights Claims (supplemental to federal complaint)
court: California Superior Court (venue TBD) or NDCA via supplemental jurisdiction (28 USC §1367)
status: NOT YET FILED — state claims to be filed as supplemental to federal §1983 action or separately in state court

claims.theory: Bane Act — defendants used threats, intimidation, and coercion to interfere with plaintiff's constitutional rights (custody, due process, privacy). Specific intent to violate per Cornell/Reese.
Inalienable right to privacy — surveillance, SIM swap interception, medical record access, communications monitoring
Unreasonable search and seizure — warrantless entry, warrantless detention (June 16, 2023 incident)
Due process and equal protection — custody deprivation without hearing, unequal treatment

remedies.unruh_if_applicable: Treble damages (up to 3x actual, min $4,000) + fees under §52
remedies.entity_liability: Gov. Code §815.2 — public entity vicariously liable for employee torts within scope of employment

note: State claims can be filed in federal court under supplemental jurisdiction (§1367) with the §1983 action, or separately in California Superior Court. Government tort claim presentation required for state-law tort claims against public entities (Gov. Code §910+), but NOT for §1983 claims (Felder v. Casey).
